kedge.definition:
n. To move (a vessel) by carrying out a kedge in a boat,
   dropping it overboard, and hauling the vessel up to it.
v. t. A small anchor used whenever a large one can be dispensed
   witch. See Kedge, v. t., and Anchor, n.
